subject: Next steps & security evidence — Quantix Health
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@quantixhealth.com>, Alex Chen <alex.chen@quantixhealth.com>, Tom Evans <tom.evans@quantixhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 16:15:00 -0800
Subject: Next steps & security evidence — Quantix Health

Hi Sara / Alex / Tom —

Great to meet this morning. Quick recap from our discovery + agreed next steps so we stay aligned:

1) Key decision criteria you called out:
   - Security & compliance posture (SOC 2 Type II, pen test summary, KMS/HSM integration)
   - Data retention & audit log access windows (30/90/365 day scenarios)
   - Latency SLOs for inference (95th p95 < 250ms target)
   - Predictable cost / reserved capacity options (Dedicated)

2) Stakeholders we mapped on the call:
   - Economic buyer: Sara Liu (CTO) — overall purchase + budget
   - InfoSec reviewer: Alex Chen — needs SOC2/pen test + questionnaire answers
   - Procurement: Tom Evans — contract/PO and timelines
   - Legal: Gina Park (looping if redlines)

3) Agreed next steps:
   - Ben: Share SOC 2 summary + pen test statement and sample logs by EOD Monday (Feb 23) — delivered via secure share.
   - Alex: Send the Quantix security questionnaire (if you have one) or confirm any additional artifacts you need.
   - Tom: Share procurement timeline and required contracting terms; Ben to provide standard SOW/contract template.
   - Marissa/Dev: Stand by to prep technical deep-dive and demo once InfoSec signs off.

I'll attach the SOC2 summary and pen test statement in the secure package; we will redact customer-identifying details before sharing the full artifacts.

If I missed anything, flag it here. Otherwise I'll send the secure bundle early next week.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment stubs: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, redwood-pen-test-statement.pdf
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@quantixhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Liu <sara.liu@quantixhealth.com>, Tom Evans <tom.evans@quantixhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Next steps & security evidence — Quantix Health

Thanks Ben — appreciate the recap. Two quick asks from InfoSec before we schedule a deeper technical review:

1) Please provide:
   - SOC 2 Type II report or summary of scope + auditor (we understand redacted copies are common).
   - High-level pen test statement (scope, date, critical/medium findings if any) and whether remediation is complete.
   - Example audit log output (timestamped tokens/requests removed) and retention policy details.
   - Data retention policy and supported timeframes + deletion/portability procedures.

2) We have a short security questionnaire — I attached it to this reply (Quantix-Security-Questionnaire.xlsx). Please have someone from your security team fill or provide an alternate format.

Timing: If we can get the artifacts by EOD Tuesday (Feb 24) it will keep us on track for a procurement review the week of Mar 2.

Alex Chen
Head of Information Security
Quantix Health
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@quantixhealth.com>, Sara Liu <sara.liu@quantixhealth.com>, Tom Evans <tom.evans@quantixhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 07:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Next steps & security evidence — Quantix Health

Hi Alex — thanks for the clear list. We're on it. Quick notes:

- SOC 2: We'll share a redacted SOC 2 Type II summary (scope, auditor, coverage dates) and a summary PDF by end of day today. Full report can be shared under an NDA if needed.
- Pen test: We'll share our latest pen test statement and remediation notes (redwood-pen-test-statement.pdf).
- Audit logs: Attached a small redacted sample (redwood-logs-sample.txt) plus a short note on retention policy (we retain request logs for 90 days by default; extended retention available under Dedicated/Private agreements).
- Questionnaire: Marissa and our security team will complete or provide answers inline to your spreadsheet — expect an initial pass by EOD tomorrow.

I'm sharing a secure bundle via the link below (internal secure share) — let me know if you need a different transfer method.

Secure share: https://redwood.app/secure-share/QH-2026-134

I'll also coordinate a 30-minute technical call with Marissa (solutions engineer) and Dev (infrastructure/secure deploy) for next week. When are you available?

Thanks,
Ben

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, redwood-pen-test-statement.pdf, redwood-logs-sample.txt
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Next steps & security evidence — prepping SOC2 bundle

Ben / Marissa —

I'll prepare the SOC2 summary and redacted artifacts. Notes for sharing:

- Redact customer names and IP addresses from log samples.
- Provide the auditor name and coverage period (we'll include the auditor engagement letter stub).
- Provide a high-level pen test summary (we don't share full reports without an NDA).
- Include a short doc describing our retention policy and KMS/HSM integration for customer keys.

I can have the bundle staged in the secure share by 2pm PT today. Marissa, can you coordinate filling the Quantix questionnaire (Alex attached) with security? I'll review before we send.

Thanks,
Dev
Dev Patel | Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Tom Evans <tom.evans@quantixhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Liu <sara.liu@quantixhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Next steps & security evidence — Quantix Health

Ben —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Two procurement items: 1) expected contracting timeline (we're aiming to finalize by Mar 12), and 2) any standard terms that typically require legal review (data processing addendum, SLAs, liability caps). Do you have a standard SOW/contract we can circulate?

If you can share a draft by EOD Wed (Feb 25) that gives us time to review ahead of the Mar 12 date.

Regards,
Tom Evans
Director of Procurement
Quantix Health
